1/S0.subgoal: Identify the core terms of the course and the questions they prompt regarding their meaning and significance.

1/S1.subgoal: Describe common public perceptions and misconceptions of XR technologies like VR, AR, and MR.

1/S2.subgoal: Explain XR as an umbrella term for immersive technologies and define the concept of immersion.

1/S3.subgoal: Describe the reality-virtuality continuum and how it defines the relationship between AR, VR, and MR.

1/S4.subgoal: Explain the commercial and professional significance of the XR field, including market growth and career opportunities.

1/S5.subgoal: Describe the course objectives, the structure of the learning modules, and the specific case study to be used.

1/S6.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
